anomalies.description: A sudden, bright orange explosion with debris radiating outward in space, consistent with a missile detonation.
A bright, fiery explosion with outward-radiating debris and sparks occurs against a black background, consistent with a high-energy blast in space or vacuum.

The man in the suit is captured in a dynamic strike motion, leaning forward with clenched fist extended, suggesting continued physical confrontation in the tunnel.

A person in the foreground is holding a firearm and aiming down a corridor toward a running man; muzzle flash or bullet impact is not visible, but the posture and framing strongly indicate active shooting.
